import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im = Image.open('/app/code.png').convert('L')
A = 255 - np.array(im, dtype=np.float32)

def sub_glyphs(x0, x1, y0, y1, name, thresh=25, mingap=2):
    sub = A[y0:y1, x0:x1]
    colink = (sub > thresh).any(axis=0)
    # find gaps of >= mingap
    parts = []
    x = 0
    W = len(colink)
    while x < W:
        if colink[x]:
            s = x
            while x < W and colink[x]:
                x += 1
            parts.append((s, x))
        else:
            x += 1
    # merge parts separated by < mingap
    merged = []
    for s,e in parts:
        if merged and s - merged[-1][1] < mingap:
            merged[-1] = (merged[-1][0], e)
        else:
            merged.append((s,e))
    print(f"== {name} x[{x0}:{x1}]: {len(merged)} parts ==")
    for i,(s,e) in enumerate(merged):
        p = sub[:, s:e]
        ys = np.where((p>thresh).any(axis=1))[0]
        p = p[ys.min():ys.max()+1]
        print(f"--- part{i} x[{x0+s}:{x0+e}] w={e-s} h={p.shape[0]} ---")
        for r in p:
            print(''.join('#' if v>thresh else ' ' for v in r))

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im = Image.open('/app/code.png').convert('L')
A = 255 - np.array(im, dtype=np.float32)

def sub_glyphs(x0, x1, y0, y1, name, thresh=60, mingap=1):
    sub = A[y0:y1, x0:x1]
    colink = (sub > thresh).any(axis=0)
    parts = []
    x = 0
    W = len(colink)
    while x < W:
        if colink[x]:
            s = x
            while x < W and colink[x]:
                x += 1
            parts.append((s, x))
        else:
            x += 1
    merged = []
    for s,e in parts:
        if merged and s - merged[-1][1] <= mingap:
            merged[-1] = (merged[-1][0], e)
        else:
            merged.append((s,e))
    print(f"== {name}: {len(merged)} parts (thresh={thresh}) ==")
    for i,(s,e) in enumerate(merged):
        p = sub[:, s:e]
        ys = np.where((p>10).any(axis=1))[0]
        p2 = p[ys.min():ys.max()+1]
        print(f"--- part{i} x[{x0+s}:{x0+e}] w={e-s} top={ys.min()+y0} bot={ys.max()+y0} h={p2.shape[0]} ---")
        for r in p2:
            print(''.join('#' if v>10 else ' ' for v in r))
